name: spinlock
title: A spinlock
summary: Every worker takes one lock, increments the counter inside it, does some busy work, and releases it; the page counts the increments and the spins each worker made waiting.

controls.name: operation
controls.label: Acquire
controls.hint: tas: test-and-set, an atomic exchange. ttas: spin on a load, then exchange. broken: a load, then a store.

results.name: expected
results.label: Expected
results.what: workers times critical sections per worker

results.name: observed
results.label: Observed
results.what: the counter after the last worker finished

results.name: spins
results.label: Spins
results.what: iterations every worker spent waiting for the lock, added up

results.name: elapsed
results.label: Elapsed
results.what: from the start barrier opening to the last worker finishing

trace.what: a model of each worker's exchange, critical section and release, where a spinning worker takes steps that do nothing
